title: Homology preserves exact colimits of complexes

from.place: Representative comparison: homology of the termwise colimit

statement: For an abelian category C, a category I, and a complex shape c on an index type ι, if C has colimits of shape I and those colimits are exact, then for every i : ι, HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor C c i preserves colimits of shape I. This holds without a filteredness assumption.

proof.text: The already-proved source instance identifies complex homology with short-complex homology. In the functor category homology is computed pointwise. Exactness of colim preserves the short-complex homology data and its kernel/cokernel maps. Transport the resulting colimit comparison along homologyFunctorIso. This node attaches the existing source proof and adds no Lean obligation.
